summary: Firy Inc. (formerly Skillz) filed an 8-K reporting an October 2, 2026 Share Sale and Transfer Agreement to sell all 14,708 shares it held in Exit Games GmbH, representing roughly 10.5% of Exit Games' outstanding share capital, to Exit Games for $55.0 million cash; the deal closed the same day, eliminating Firy's entire equity stake and shareholder status. No board recommendation, advisor, premium or regulatory clock is disclosed. As a full-stake minority-position sale with immediate settlement, there is no residual overhang; the key watch item is how management deploys the $55 million in cash and whether the press release discloses any tax or gain implications.
